correctness.rationale: Checked the exact distance taxonomy for original vertices u∈U,v∈V and subdivision vertices e_ij: original same-part distance4, opposite-part distance2; midpoints distance2 iff their edges share an endpoint, else distance4; every original-to-midpoint distance1 or3. Hence the scale3 threshold graph is EXACTLY K_{m,n} joined with the rook graph L(K_{m,n}), and its clique complex is the simplicial join. The row/column maximal-simplex cover of the rook clique complex has contractible nonempty intersections and nerve K_{m,n}, so each factor is wedge^b S1; their join is wedge^{b²} S3 integrally. At scale2 Adamaszek Theorem 5.1 and the explicit triangle-free total-graph collapse identify the subdivided 1-cycle lattice with K_{m,n}; this proves the persistence isomorphism, not just equal ranks. At scale4 all vertex distances ≤4. Independently computed all-pairs graph distances and basic ranks for (m,n)=(2,2),(2,3),(3,3),(3,4),(4,5); exact symbolic taxonomy covers all parameters.
